name: Martyrs Caesarius, Dacius, Sabbas, Sabinian, Agrippa, Adrian, and Thomas at Damascus (7th c.)
life: Martyrs Caesarius, Dacius and five other martyrs suffered for Christ in Damascus during its capture by the Mohammedans in the Seventh Century. St. Caesarius and Dacius were beheaded. The names of the five martyrs who suffered with them are the following: Sabbas, Sabinian, Agrippa, Adrian and Thomas.
